query: Beyond the initial approval from AICTE, what are the critical compliance requirements and affiliations an institution must secure and maintain to legally operate a B.Pharmacy course and avoid penalties, as outlined in this resolution?
expected_answer: An institution must obtain approval/affiliation from the concerned university as per the Maharashtra Public Universities Act, 2016. They must also secure the requisite approval from the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI) as per Section 12 of the Pharmacy Act, 1948, and the B.Pharm Course Regulation, 2014. Additionally, they must ensure fees do not exceed those prescribed by the Fee Regulatory Authority, appoint full-time faculty and other technical staff, maintain library standards as per AICTE, and strictly implement anti-ragging measures as per the Supreme Court directions and the Maharashtra Prohibition of Ragging Act, 1999.
